699/116
Shanghai Municipal Council.
November 4th 191
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL POLICE FORCE (DETECTIVE BRANCH)）
Sir,
It is reported that the mother and widow of Huang Hsing are coming from Japan and that the French Police have given permission to have the coffin kept in his house until their arrival.
It is reported that the Chinese Chamber of Commerce here has written a letter to the French Municipal Council exhorting them to use their influence to bring about a peaceful solution of the Tientsin incident. The letter promises that the prominent merchants would use their influence to prevent a boycott of French goods.
Some time ago the rebel leaders here decided to entertain the French Consul and other officials in Frenchtown to a farewell party as a token of gratitude for the protection of the French Authorities during the past five years. This function has been postponed until the Laoushikai incident has been peacefully settled.
Your Obedient Servant,
Detective Sub Inspector.
Captain Superintendent of Police.

上海工部局。
191 年 11 月 4 日
（印：上海工部局警务处（侦探股））

先生：

据报，黄兴之母及其遗孀正从日本前来，法国巡捕房已许可将其灵柩停放在其寓所内，直至她们抵达。

据报，本地华商总会已致函法国公董局，促请该局运用其影响力，促成天津事件的和平解决。信中承诺，知名商人将运用其影响力，防止发生抵制法货之举。

前些时候，本地的反叛领袖们决定在法租界宴请法国领事及其他官员，举行告别宴会，以感谢法国当局在过去五年中提供的保护。该活动已推迟，待老西开事件和平解决后再行举办。

您顺从的仆人，
副探长
警司
